name: Python
description: Run Python files or use an interactive Python prompt.

changelog.2.0.0: No more IPython: run files or use a plain Python prompt straight away. Also: python <file>, python -c.
changelog.2.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
changelog.2.0.2: Declares where it works: Windows and Linux (it starts the Python interpreter, which the locked-down ISO and Android do not allow).
